groups.name: head
face
groups.note: Head skin from forehead through jaw, both ears, and facial features; eyes, brows, mouth, and ear occlusion need separate controls later.

groups.name: hair
groups.note: All brown hair: crown, bangs, face-framing locks, flyaways, and completed rear curtain down to both hip-level tips; front and rear locks sway and overlap differently.

groups.name: hair_bow
groups.note: White bow and flower at the viewer-right temple; knot, loops, and tails sway differently, while the flower differs from the fabric in stiffness.
头部、五官、发饰与全部长发；长发延伸至腰臀两侧。

parts.name: bang_hairpin
parts.note: Thin curved rigid pin crossing the viewer-right bangs above the eye.

groups.name: neck
groups.note: 下颌至锁骨上方的可见颈部。

groups.name: body
chest
groups.note: 锁骨、胸廓和双侧胸部至下肋缘；双侧胸部需要分别软变形。

groups.name: necklace
groups.note: 颈前垂至胸口的项链；链条与吊坠的摆动和软硬变形不同。
锁骨、肩、胸和腹部至肚脐附近；项链归此范围。

parts.name: left_shoulder
parts.note: 角色左肩（画面右侧）的肩峰和三角肌肩帽，随左臂独立抬转。

parts.name: right_shoulder
parts.note: 角色右肩（画面左侧）的肩峰和三角肌肩帽，随右臂独立抬转。

parts.name: abdomen
parts.note: 下肋缘至腰线的腹部，独立于胸廓弯曲；按连体服下的身体推断。

groups.name: arms
groups.note: 双臂和双手，包括抬起持杯的手。

groups.name: pelvis
groups.note: 肚脐附近至胯部及双侧髋部的骨盆范围。

groups.name: legs
groups.note: 双腿和双脚，包含腿套与鞋。

groups.name: mug
groups.note: 抬起的手所持马克杯，包含杯身与杯柄。
